In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Al0.8Si0.2N coatings deposited on the Cu substrate are the best choice for the diffusion barrier application.
the Al0.8Si0.2N coating is the best candidate for the Cu substrate protection against diffusion at temperatures up to 1000 ° C.
the Al0.8Si0.2N coating is characterized by the best thermal cycling resistance and barrier performance against copper out-diffusion from the substrate.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a high Al/Si ratio is beneficial for improving the thermal cycling performance of AlxSiN coatings on Cu substrates.
the thermal cycling resistance of AlxSiN coatings deposited on copper substrates is improved by increasing the Al content.
the thermal cycling resistance of AlxSi 1-xN coatings deposited on the copper substrates is strongly dependent on their structure and chemical composition.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a proper selection of Al/Si ratio is a key factor for improving the performance of Al-Si-N coatings as a diffusion barrier on Cu substrates.
the coatings with a low content of Si in the Al-Si-N phase exhibit the best thermal cycling resistance.
the AlxSi1–xN coating with an Al/Si ratio of 0.88/0.12 is an effective barrier against copper diffusion from Cu substrate at temperatures up to 1000 ° C.
